bugClass.title: Vault lookup omits the site matching key
bugClass.cause: A saved credential lookup uses only the requested service or entry name for equality, while the saved login is associated with a site/domain and the request omits that site identifier. This makes an existing login appear missing and can trigger an unnecessary request to save the password again.
bugClass.criteria: Include a site when credential retrieval matches saved logins against a request using service/entry-name equality alone, with no site/domain/URL matching key supplied or considered. Also include when a broker or adapter drops the site/domain/URL field before forwarding a credential lookup. Either mechanism independently qualifies. Exclude cases where the request and lookup consistently use a canonical site/domain key or the item is absent for a different reason.

candidates.evidence: Lines 97–107 find a broker entry using ticket and uid, then return its saved request. The excerpt does not show credential retrieval, a service/entry-name-only comparison, or omission of a site/domain key from a forwarded lookup.
Line 41 declares a `site` field on an approval queue entry, but this type excerpt does not show credential lookup, forwarding, or whether lookup matching uses that field.
